_meta.note: Agent harnesses: Harness-Bench v2 site DATA (exact JSON), Artificial Analysis Coding Agents RSC rows (exact JSON), reader outputs checked line-by-line by tools/verify.py.

models.name: OpenCode
models._note: Open-source terminal coding agent (MIT, TypeScript) by SST / Anomaly; any model provider (BYO). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Muse Code
models._note: Meta coding agent harness for Muse models (Artificial Analysis Coding Agents row "Muse Code"). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Antigravity CLI
models._note: Google Antigravity command-line coding agent (Artificial Analysis Coding Agents row). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Antigravity SDK
models._note: Google Antigravity agent SDK (v0.1.12 on Artificial Analysis Coding Agents). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Devin Fusion CLI
models._note: Cognition CLI agent that pairs a frontier planner model with Cognition SWE-2 as executor. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Kimi Code CLI
models._note: Moonshot AI terminal coding agent for Kimi models. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Devin Fusion: Claude Fable 5.1 (xhigh) + SWE-2 (medium)
models._note: Compound system measured by Artificial Analysis in the Devin Fusion CLI harness: Claude Fable 5.1 at xhigh effort paired with Cognition SWE-2 at medium effort.

models.name: Devin Fusion: GPT-6 Astra (xhigh) + SWE-2 (medium)
models._note: Compound system measured by Artificial Analysis in the Devin Fusion CLI harness: GPT-6 Astra at xhigh effort paired with Cognition SWE-2 at medium effort.

models.name: Devin Fusion: GPT-6 Astra (high) + SWE-2 (medium)
models._note: Sidekick ablation in Cognition's Fusion launch post (2026-09-11). Registered in S304.

models.name: Fusion ablation: GPT-6 Astra (high) + GPT-5.6 Luna (high) sidekick
models._note: Sidekick ablation in Cognition's Fusion launch post (2026-09-11): Luna instead of SWE-2 as sidekick. Registered in S304.

models.name: Devin Fusion (pairing not stated)
models._note: Cognition Devin Fusion multi-model system; the FrontierCode chart (2026-06-29) does not state the model pairing. Registered in S304.

models.name: Claude Fable 5 (xhigh)
models._note: Claude Fable 5 at xhigh effort (Cognition FrontierCode chart, 2026-06-29). Registered in S304.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
models._note: Qwen3-Coder 30B total / 3.3B active MoE coding model (open weights, Apache-2.0). Registered in S304 for harness benchmark rows.

models.name: GenericAgent
models._note: Minimal self-evolving autonomous agent (~3K-line seed, 9 atomic tools, ~100-line agent loop) that crystallises each solved task into a reusable skill; used as a Claw-SWE-Bench harness and as the seed for Meta-Harness evolution there. Repo https://github.com/lsdefine/GenericAgent. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.vendor: Stanford IRIS Lab (Lee, Nair, Zhang, Lee, Khattab, Finn)
models.name: Meta-Harness
models._note: End-to-end harness optimisation (arXiv 2603.28052): a coding-agent proposer reads prior harness source, scores and execution traces and writes new harness candidates around a fixed base model. In Claw-SWE-Bench it was run one round from GenericAgent with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (xhigh) as proposer, evolved and evaluated on the same 350 tasks. Repo https://github.com/stanford-iris-lab/meta-harness. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
models._note: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness built on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture (Cordis); developer preview with a web UI (npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web). One of the 7 harnesses in Claw-SWE-Bench. Repo https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: OpenSquilla
models._note: Token-efficient microkernel agent whose on-device router sends each turn to the cheapest capable model, with persistent memory and a layered sandbox; from the Claw-SWE-Bench authors, used as the held-out harness in the Lite-80 validation. Repo https://github.com/TokenRhythm/opensquilla. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE)
models._note: Observability-driven harness-evolution loop (Lin et al., 2026) that evolves prompts, tools, middleware, skills and long-term memory; used (explore agent disabled) as the Harness Evolution method and its initial harness h1 as the fixed harness in the Rethinking paper. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.vendor: Wang, Zhu et al. (AI2 / UW), arXiv 2607.12227
models.name: Harness Scaling
models._note: Instance-guided harness adaptation introduced as a harness-level analogue of test-time scaling: after each trajectory a meta agent (same model) revises the harness for that single task and resamples. Repo https://github.com/rethinking-harness-evolution. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: VISTA (ARC-AGI-3 visual harness)
models._note: Strong visual harness for ARC-AGI-3 running on Claude Code / Codex with raw PNG observations, lossless visual memory and inspection tools; VISTA* = memory evolution disabled. Seed for Harness Scaling in the Rethinking paper. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.vendor: University of Notre Dame (Huang et al.)
models.name: MemoHarness
models._note: Searches a six-dimensional harness space (context, tools, decoding, orchestration, memory, output) from a minimal harness, storing per-case diagnoses and distilled global patterns in a dual-layer experience bank; at test time adapts the learned global harness to each case without labels or extra search. Evaluated on Terminal-Bench (89-task suite, 18-task held-out), LiveCodeBench, FinanceAgent. Repo https://github.com/HowieHwong/MemoHarness. License none declared (GitHub license: null). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: TTHE (Test-Time Harness Evolution)
models._note: Evolves the executable harness (a Python class, starting from ReAct or mini-swe-agent / OpenClaw) during evaluation on unlabeled test batches: agentic proposers rewrite harness code from execution traces and proxy signals, a judge commits one harness that persists to later batches. Gold labels used only for measurement (transductive scoring). Repo https://github.com/junnie00/TTHE. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: EvolveNet
models._note: Collaborative harness evolution: a shared harness is broadcast to K data-local clients that each evolve it on their own workload; a server composes the returned program deltas with scope-typed (global vs home-domain) evidence-guided aggregation and a per-item validation gate, then redistributes. Uses labels (supervised), unlike TTHE. Repo https://github.com/junnie00/EvolveNet. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: ReAct (reason+act agent loop)
models._note: Standard reasoning-and-acting scaffold interleaving reasoning with tool calls; used as the fixed baseline harness H0 that TTHE evolves (BIRD, LiveCodeBench, DS-1000). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Pi (pi coding agent)
models._note: Minimal open-source terminal coding agent; plain-agent baseline on XBOW (GPT-5) in arXiv 2607.13085. Vendor/id attribution from general knowledge, paper only says "Pi". Repo https://github.com/earendil-works/pi. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Oh My Pi (omp)
models._note: Fork of Pi by Stencil Labs; "60+ providers, 31 built-in tools". Highest pass rate (22/25, 88%) in Composio's Kimi K3 harness comparison; headline harness of the aarora79 agentic-coding benchmark. Repo https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Kiro CLI
models._note: Amazon's Kiro agent (one unified harness across IDE/CLI/Web/Mobile). Harness kiro-cli in the aarora79 benchmark (/swe3 v1, 5 models). Repo https://github.com/kirodotdev/Kiro. License proprietary (public repo is an issue tracker only). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Strands Agents SDK (hand-built agent / create_harness)
models._note: Open-source SDK for building agent harnesses; ships a preassembled coding agent via create_harness(). Run in aarora79 both as a hand-built Strands agent (`strands`) and as `strands-harness`. Repo https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Agentic Harness Arena
models._note: Not a harness itself: an LMSYS-style blind arena that runs the same task + model through several harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenClaw, Hermes, opencode, OnDemand) and ranks them by Elo from human votes. Listed here as evaluation infrastructure; see benchmark harness_arena_elo. Repo https://github.com/Ondemand-OSS/harness-arena. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Cursor CLI (agent)
models._note: Terminal version of Cursor's agent; print mode for scripts/CI, sandbox modes, and "&" to push a conversation to a Cloud Agent. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Factory Droid CLI
models._note: Factory's terminal agent: same Factory runtime as the Factory app, with multi-agent Missions, Custom Droids, Skills, MCP, Hooks, Plugins and droid exec automation. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Warp (Agentic Development Environment, Warp Agent CLI, Warp Factories)
models._note: Warp open-sourced its terminal/ADE (AGPL-3.0, OpenAI founding sponsor) and offers a Warp Agent CLI plus "Factories" that run fleets of Warp/Claude Code/Codex agents with shared memory and context. Repo https://github.com/warpdotdev/warp. License AGPL-3.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
models._note: Terminal agent "powered by the same agentic harness as GitHub's Copilot coding agent", shipping GitHub's MCP server by default. Repo https://github.com/github/copilot-cli. License proprietary (repo NOASSERTION). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Kiro (IDE / CLI / Web / Crew)
models._note: AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE/CLI; Kiro CLI replaced the open-source Amazon Q Developer CLI and one harness powers IDE, CLI, Web (cloud sandboxes) and the open-source Kiro Crew. Repo https://github.com/kirodotdev/Kiro. License proprietary (issues repo, no license). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Amazon Q Developer CLI (legacy, superseded by Kiro CLI)
models._note: Open-source Rust agentic terminal chat; now maintenance-only (critical security fixes) after AWS moved it to the closed-source Kiro CLI. Repo https://github.com/aws/amazon-q-developer-cli. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: CodeBuddy Code (CLI)
models._note: Tencent's terminal agent "Use CodeBuddy, Tencent's AI assistant, right from your terminal"; distributed via npm @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code. Repo https://cnb.cool/codebuddy/codebuddy-code. License SEE LICENSE IN README.md (npm). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: MiMo Code (MiMoCode CLI)
models._note: Fork of OpenCode by Xiaomi MiMo adding persistent cross-session memory, checkpoint-based context reconstruction, subagent orchestration and self-improvement; DB also has the version entry xiaomi/mimocode-cli-v0.1. Repo https://github.com/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Code. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Mistral Vibe
models._note: "Minimal CLI coding agent by Mistral" (Python, Apache-2.0), with subagent task delegation, a skills system and MCP configuration. Repo https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-vibe. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: iFlow CLI
models._note: Chinese terminal agent offering free access to open models through the iFlow platform with SubAgents, hooks and an open market for MCP tools. Repo https://github.com/iflow-ai/iflow-cli. License none (repo has no LICENSE). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Crush
models._note: Charm's Go TUI coding agent with MCP (http/stdio/sse) support; FSL-1.1-MIT licensed. Repo https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush. License FSL-1.1-MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Kilo Code
models._note: MIT-licensed agentic engineering platform (VS Code, JetBrains, CLI) with a marketplace and autonomous CI mode. Repo https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Zed Agent (Agent Panel)
models._note: Zed's built-in agent plus ACP host that can run external agent harnesses in the Agent Panel. Repo https://github.com/zed-industries/zed. License GPL-3.0-or-later (primarily) + Apache-2.0 components. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Terminus 2 (Terminal-Bench / Harbor reference agent)
models._note: Reference terminal agent of Terminal-Bench/Harbor: a single tmux session driven by JSON/XML command parsing with built-in context summarization; repo stats are for harbor-framework/harbor. Repo https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Harbor (agent evaluation framework)
models._note: "Framework for evaluating and improving agents" that runs many third-party harnesses on the same tasks — the main infra for harness-vs-harness comparisons. Repo https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Trae Agent
models._note: ByteDance's open-source LLM agent for general software-engineering tasks (research-friendly CLI; Trae IDE agent is separate). Repo https://github.com/bytedance/trae-agent. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Letta Code
models._note: Stateful agent harness where agents keep memory/identity across sessions and rewrite their own context (self-improvement). Repo https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: ForgeCode
models._note: Rust terminal pair-programmer supporting 300+ models, with git-worktree sandboxes and MCP. Repo https://github.com/tailcallhq/forgecode. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Plandex
models._note: Go terminal agent for large projects with a cumulative diff-review sandbox; last CLI release 2025-07. Repo https://github.com/plandex-ai/plandex. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: smolagents
models._note: Barebones library for agents that act by writing code (CodeAgent); model- and tool-agnostic. Repo https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents. License Apache-2.0. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: OpenAI Agents SDK (Python)
models._note: Lightweight multi-agent framework with SandboxAgent for long-horizon container work. Repo https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Claude Agent SDK (Python)
models._note: Python SDK exposing the Claude Code agent harness; custom tools are in-process MCP servers and hooks are Python functions. Used by NanoClaw. Repo https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Deep Agents (+ Deep Agents Code)
models._note: "The batteries-included agent harness" on top of LangGraph/create_agent, with sub-agents, memory, skills and a pre-built terminal coding agent. Repo https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents. License MIT. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Exgentic ReAct (first-party general agent)
models._note: Minimal first-party ReAct agent shipped with the Exgentic evaluation harness; LiteLLM tool-calling over Unified Protocol actions. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: Exgentic ReAct Short (ReAct + tool shortlisting)
models._note: Exgentic ReAct variant that asks the same backbone to shortlist the 30 most relevant tools before each call when >30 actions exist (fixes GPT 5.2 128-tool limit on AppWorld). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.vendor: UMass Amherst / Emory / Zoom / UNC Charlotte
models.name: Harness-design study coding harness (LangGraph ReAct, modular)
models._note: Lightweight from-scratch ReAct coding harness whose planning, action space and context-management components can be toggled independently; used for 176 matched ablation settings on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1. Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

models.name: AutoLab Auto Harness (evolved Claude Code harness)
models._note: Outer loop driven by Claude-Opus-4.8 that evolves the Claude Code harness (preamble, in-context rules, thin hook layer) over 4 rounds on 3 System Optimization tasks; +0.12 avg@3 on seed tasks, +0.06 held-out SysOpt, +0.03 on GPT-5.5, no clear gain on other families (Figure 10, deltas only). Registered in S304 (Harness tab).

benchmarks.name: HarnessOpt-Bench — LSS-λ optimiser model effect (gain units)
benchmarks.metric: LSS-λ: model term of additive task+model fit on normalised gain, opencode-only balanced grid over OfficeQA/BrowseComp-Plus/Terminal-Bench (resolution ±0.058)
benchmarks.description: HarnessOpt-Bench (Scale AI, arXiv 2608.06301, Aug 2026): benchmark of LLMs AS HARNESS OPTIMISERS. An optimiser (LLM + coding harness) receives a deliberately naive pinned seed harness H0 for a target agent, graded feedback (dev split: per-case traces; val split: aggregate score only) and a fixed target-evaluation budget (100 eval calls/partition, 4 full case passes on dev and val, target-token cap), edits the Python harness and nominates one candidate scored on a never-visible held-out test split (K=3 attempts per case) inside a trusted execution environment built on VeRO. 4 tasks with one pinned target model each: OfficeQA Pro (deepseek-v4-flash), BrowseComp-Plus (deepseek-v4-flash), Terminal-Bench 2.0 (grok-build), GAIA (gpt-5.4-mini; seed is a non-functional stub). 5 optimiser models (claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, kimi-k3) x shared harness opencode + native harness (claude-code / codex / kimi-cli), plus goose and mini-swe-agent on GAIA; 111 scored runs, 2 rounds per configuration. Table 4: task-adjusted optimiser-model effect relative to the 5-model grand mean; tiers cut at ±0.058. URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06301

benchmarks.name: ArchEval — L1 geomean
benchmarks.metric: baseline-normalized performance (x, geomean/median over valid submissions)
benchmarks.description: ArchEval (arXiv 2607.03601, Harvard/MIT, 2026-07-03): 20 computer-architecture design challenges across 5 domains (CPU core, system, memory, DNN accelerators, compute-in-memory) backed by 8 simulators (ChampSim, gem5, ASTRA-sim, DRAMSys, Ramulator 2.0, SCALE-Sim v3, Timeloop, MNSim). Settings: L1 full harness (prepared harness + repeated verifier-simulator feedback, verifier cap 5), L2 simulator-code container (source available, agent builds its own workflow, cap 5), L3 agent-only (static workload evidence, no simulator feedback, 1 submission). Agents: GPT-5.5 + Codex CLI backend; Gemini 3.5 Flash / Gemma 4 31B / Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite + lightly modified Mini-SWE agent; one run per agent/challenge/setting. Metric: L1 geomean (Table 10). 1.0x = challenge baseline; win rate counts all 20 challenges. URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03601

benchmarks.name: AutoLab-36 Overall avg@3
benchmarks.description: AutoLab long-horizon automated R&D evaluation (arXiv 2608.13417, Meituan/UCAS, 2026-08-13): 36 expert-curated AutoLab tasks (7 Model Development, 15 System Optimization, 10 Puzzle & Challenge, 4 CUDA), each with a suboptimal starting artifact, expert reference, 2-12 h wall-clock budget and automated verifier giving a normalized 0-1 score; 3 rollouts per model-task. Main comparison: 7 models under a shared Claude Code v2.1.152 harness; harness comparison: Claude Code vs native harness (Codex CLI v0.142.4 for GPT-5.5, Kimi Code CLI v0.24.1 for Kimi) vs OpenCode v1.17.18. Metric: avg@3 (mean of 3 rollouts) on the Overall slice. URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13417

benchmarks.name: HarnessOpt-Bench — OfficeQA (normalized gain) — Claude Code
benchmarks.metric: normalized gain g = (E(H+) - E(H0)) / (1 - E(H0)) on held-out test; higher better, can be negative
benchmarks.description: HarnessOpt-Bench (Scale AI, arXiv 2608.06301, Aug 2026): benchmark of LLMs AS HARNESS OPTIMISERS. An optimiser (LLM + coding harness) receives a deliberately naive pinned seed harness H0 for a target agent, graded feedback (dev split: per-case traces; val split: aggregate score only) and a fixed target-evaluation budget (100 eval calls/partition, 4 full case passes on dev and val, target-token cap), edits the Python harness and nominates one candidate scored on a never-visible held-out test split (K=3 attempts per case) inside a trusted execution environment built on VeRO. 4 tasks with one pinned target model each: OfficeQA Pro (deepseek-v4-flash), BrowseComp-Plus (deepseek-v4-flash), Terminal-Bench 2.0 (grok-build), GAIA (gpt-5.4-mini; seed is a non-functional stub). 5 optimiser models (claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, kimi-k3) x shared harness opencode + native harness (claude-code / codex / kimi-cli), plus goose and mini-swe-agent on GAIA; 111 scored runs, 2 rounds per configuration. This id: OfficeQA task; row model = optimiser LLM, harness = the optimiser's coding harness. URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06301 Harness: Claude Code. Setting: optimiser; native harness; mean of rounds, range (0.54–0.64).

benchmarks.name: Composio harness comparison (Kimi K3, 25 business-app tool-use tasks) — pass rate — Oh My Pi (omp)
benchmarks.description: Composio (blog, Aug 4 2026, Sunil Kumar Dash) ran moonshotai/kimi-k3 via OpenRouter at maximum reasoning through 8 harnesses (Oh My Pi, Kimi Code, Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Pi Agent, OpenCode, Grok Build, Codex) with identical hosted Composio MCP tools, task instructions and app data; 25 valid tasks (5 removed) across Gmail/Calendar/Sheets/Airtable/GitHub/Slack/Notion/Linear/PagerDuty, scored by automated final-state checks; one scored attempt per task (200 results). Measuring party: Composio. URL: https://composio.dev/content/best-ai-agent-harnesses Harness: Oh My Pi (omp). Setting: Kimi K3 via OpenRouter, maximum reasoning, Composio hosted MCP tools; measured by Composio.
